blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—University of Santo Tomas recovered from its opening loss by nipping defending champion La Salle, 80-75, in the UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament on Wednesday night at Mall of Asia Arena. The Growling Tigers, who absorbed a 92-85 loss at the hands of last year’s losing finalist University of the Philippines on Sunday, staved off the Green Archers down the stretch thanks to crucial plays by Mark Llemit, Collins Akowe and Amiel Acido. “I don’t dwell on the past.
